results.content: # Bridging corporate purpose and strategic renewal: A review and future research agenda. There is growing interest in the strategic role of corporate purpose in processes of strategic renewal, but existing research appears fragmented and offers mixed insights. To address this issue, this study develops a systematic literature review to identify the links between corporate purpose and strategic renewal across diverse research streams. The proposed research agenda is organized around three main objectives: *testing and elaborating, contextualizing,* and *theorizing* the relationship between corporate purpose and strategic renewal. Her research focuses on understanding the relationship between corporate purpose and strategic renewal across levels of analysis, adopting mainly qualitative methods.
